steps: Read every scope_in file and each source it cites (trade ledger rows, transcript quote file:line).
Check each rule, parameter and number against its source; where a backtest is involved apply the 12 items of MyTradingSys/backtest/PRE_REG_TEMPLATE.md.

Report findings as a table: severity HIGH/MED/LOW, file:line, what is wrong, evidence, proposed fix. Change no production code, permanent test suite or spec. Mutate only disposable scratch copies and save the reproducible harness as research/layer_lab/aibridge_07x_mutation_audit.py.txt.
A source you cannot reach (video frames, data on another machine) is a NOT_IN_DATA finding, not a reason for BLOCKED: finish the audit and mark the card done.
For each HIGH finding capture a follow-up card: python scripts/dev/tasks.py new "<title>" --lane SONNET.

Execute the baseline and all 4 mutants; do not substitute source-to-assertion predictions for recorded mutation results. Derive survivor tests from the documented contract and show each passes on original and fails on its mutant. Include exact commands, mutation diffs and exit/results in the report.

For a surviving behaviour, capture the permanent regression-test fix as a follow-up SONNET build card with its required test and gate-registration paths; this audit delivers the scratch demonstration, not a permanent test file.
tests: Run the original focused tests and 4 scratch mutants. For every survivor, execute a spec-derived test that passes on original and fails on its mutant. Preserve the runnable harness as MyTradingSys/research/layer_lab/aibridge_07x_mutation_audit.py.txt, with exact copy/run commands and original/mutant outcomes in the report.
